description.value: A tidy highway RV park 8 minutes south of Prince George off Highway 97, offering modern flush washrooms, coin showers, laundry, and free wifi; tent sites are water-only at $41/night and the setting is functional rather than scenic.

raw_osm.name: Northern Experience RV Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the park is open for 2026 and corroborates OSM data on address, phone, and amenities. Website explicitly lists tent-only sites, coin-operated showers and laundry, free wifi, sani-dump, and bear-country waste disposal. Showers, laundry, and reservations are confirmed by both website text and OSM tags. No specific hiker/biker site designation or cyclist discount is mentioned. Tent-only sites do not list electrical hookups, so device/e-bike charging for tent campers cannot be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground on Highway 97 with tent-only sites, showers, laundry, and bear-aware waste management. Well-suited for touring cyclists passing through Prince George on the major north-south corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Also has a toll-free number: 877-851-6322. Free wifi available. Wheelchair-accessible washrooms and showers. Propane fire pits only (no open flames). Dogs welcome on leash, limit 2 per site.

wow_evidence: coin showers, laundry, and free wifi; tent sites
